title: The 300px conversation column never scrolls sideways, and Add site's Customize and design system steps open as pages of their own
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-force-exit packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/e2e/column-no-side-scroll.test.mjs packages/site/tracy-add-site/test/e2e/create-brief-sheet.test.mjs packages/site/tracy-add-site/test/e2e/design-system-card.test.mjs
S2: Read the test lines named in run.tests.
expect: dsh's own rules alone let a 300px conversation column scroll sideways, and with the tracy-chat-input plugin the column root cannot be scrolled sideways.
The input band's handles add nothing to the column's width, and the root clips in both axes instead of hiding.
Customize your site opens as a page in the tab, in place of the form, with the template's own questions, Recommended ones first.
The design systems open as a page in the tab, and the card sits right under Customize your site.
fence: Built plugin bundles in a headless browser over dsh's real layout CSS; not a proof of the 300px default itself, which lives in the dsh fork (ui-layout tests, tracy.48).

tests: dsh's own rules alone let the 300px column scroll sideways
with the plugin the column root cannot be scrolled sideways
with the plugin the band's handles add nothing to the column's width
the root clips instead of hiding, in both axes
the page takes the form's place with the template's own questions
the systems open as a page in the tab
the card sits right under Customize your site
